blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jovelyn Gonzaga and Rachel Daquis have been around long enough to remember when Philippine volleyball was built around the Shakey’s V-League — the predecessor of the Premier Volleyball League (PVL)— when they were still playing together for Army. A decade later, the two veterans are still playing, now with ZUS Coffee entering the Philippine pro league’s 10th season. From their prime with Army to becoming some of the league’s most experienced players, Gonzaga and Daquis have witnessed Philippine volleyball transform from a sport into a professional league producing players capable of competing on the international stage.
